reviews.comment: you have 1 major group assignment, weekly checking over lectures making attendance mandatory, and 3 exams. allows 1 extra credit opportunity (optional) in place of a final exam which you don't have. he grades pretty easy but if you miss a lot of small checking they add up hence the B in the class. lectures are interesting and relevant def recommend
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. McCullough is a great professor. He genuinely cares about each of his students and is constantly reaching out for feedback. Decent level of homework and easy tests based off of lectures, slides and the Sports Business Journal. You won't regret taking any of his courses. I love his teaching style, his lectures are engaging.
